what: The full workspace all-target check passed, then cargo test --no-run exhausted the 84 GiB Btrfs filesystem after 38 minutes 52 seconds while linking blaze-file-items' outline integration test and writing the huge example. No full-workspace test binary ran.
cost: The job spent its build budget without a full-suite execution receipt. Its raw Cargo artifact stream and completed executable inventory were discarded before the error was reported, so the final log alone cannot apportion occupied bytes.
cause: The test driver builds and retains every workspace test executable before running any. The recorded compiler invocations retain debug metadata at debug=1 alongside opt-level=3 and enabled debug assertions. The filesystem was already the declared 84 GiB; its mount and reflink proof passed. Debug metadata contributes to retained artifacts, but its byte share and any other contributors were not measured by the failed job.
class: a build retains all outputs before execution but loses its partial inventory when storage is exhausted
prevention: Keep bounded before/after filesystem and directory observations outside the measured volume, and preserve Cargo's raw build stream plus completed executable sizes before deciding whether a no-run build succeeded. Keep diagnostic failures explicit and separate from the original compiler result.
workaround: None. Do not enlarge the volume, skip required targets, remove debug assertions, claim tests executed after a failed no-run, or attribute the failure to incremental compilation without evidence.
fix: The cargo job removes debug metadata from its dev and test profiles only after the canonical toolchain shelf is produced; optimization, debug assertions, required targets and capacity remain unchanged. The test driver writes cargo-test.jsonl and executables.json even for a failed build. A Rust storage reader takes six explicit JSON fields and bounded read-only observations; always-run CI steps retain the after-build snapshot and evidence artifact. Causal runner/storage controls are required gate rows. Savings and complete workspace execution remain pending on the next hosted tree.
